Thanks Karthik — answers inline:

1) Rationale for $50k/12mo: Candidate explicitly asked for payout spread to protect him from leaving within first year; staggered retention pay (25% quarterly) reduces risk and is cost-optimized vs higher base. Market comps show one-time caps at $30k for mid-senior roles, but for hires from payments infra (lower supply) we've seen $40–60k structured sign-ons for critical hires.

2) Precedents (redacted):
- 2027-04 Senior Infra (external hire): $45k retention structured
- 2027-09 Staff LLM Ops (external): $60k one-time sign-on + smaller equity bump
- 2026-12 Sr Backend (promotion-equivalent): no sign-on

3) Equity refresh: market-driven; candidate is requesting an equity uplift to align long-term incentives. We are not normalizing refreshes broadly — this is explicitly marked as outlier for this hire.

Also confirming: sign-on is contingent on 12-month retention schedule and clawback clause in offer (standard HR template).

I can push the DocuSign once I have provisional Ok from Karthik and Marissa. Candidate is on standby until EOD Thursday, per NorthStar — they'd like paperwork in-hand.

—Priyom
